name: Harborview intro
notes: First conversation with Harborview Labs. Keira Holt (CEO) and Ben Adeyemi (ops) are rolling forecasting out to a new AE team. They do not have a sales system today beyond spreadsheets. Interested in how Helios would run a first forecast cycle.

action_items.text: Send a one-pager on a first forecast rollout for a team of Harborview's size
Share current AE headcount and the spreadsheet they use for weekly commits

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Keira, Ben — thanks for the intro time. I saw Harborview Labs on the calendar; I don't think we've spoken before. I'd love to hear what you're building and why forecasting is on your list.

transcript.speaker: Keira Holt
transcript.text: This is a first meeting, yes. I'm Keira Holt, I run Harborview Labs. We sell lab-ops software to hospital research groups. We just hired our first real AE pod — eight people — and I am done running the number out of a Google Sheet I built in 2023.

transcript.speaker: Ben Adeyemi
transcript.text: I'm Ben Adeyemi, I own ops. Keira still does the board forecast. I stitch the sheet on Friday. The new AEs each have a different idea of commit, and our first board meeting with the expanded team is in October. We need a forecast rollout that doesn't take a quarter to land.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Got it. Greenfield team, founder-built sheet, first time the number has to survive a pod instead of two people. What does success look like for that October board meeting?

transcript.speaker: Keira Holt
transcript.text: I want to walk in with a commit I didn't type myself. Ben should be able to show which deals moved and why. I don't need a giant RevOps org. Harborview Labs is still small. I need something an ops lead and a CEO can run without hiring a forecasting analyst.

transcript.speaker: Ben Adeyemi
transcript.text: The AEs are coming from bigger companies, so they ask for a real tool. If I tell them the process is the sheet, I lose them in month two. A forecast rollout is also a credibility thing internally.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Typical first rollout for a team like yours is: import the pipeline, lock a commit definition, run one manager meeting in the product, then use that recording as the template. No six-month implementation. You'd be live for the October cycle if we started in the next couple of weeks.

transcript.speaker: Keira Holt
transcript.text: That's the pace I want. We're not evaluating five vendors. I asked for this intro because a founder I know said Helios didn't drown them in professional services. If the product can carry a first forecast meeting, we should keep talking.

transcript.speaker: Ben Adeyemi
transcript.text: Two practical things. We use HubSpot for CRM today — very lightly — and Google Workspace. I can export the sheet. I cannot promise a data team. Also, hospital buyers mean we get security questionnaires. I don't want to stall a rollout on that.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: HubSpot plus a sheet is a common starting point. We'd map the fields you already trust, not redesign your CRM. Security packet is standard; I'll include it with the one-pager. Ben, if you can send headcount and a sanitized copy of the weekly commit tab, I can sketch the first four weeks against your actual deals.

transcript.speaker: Keira Holt
transcript.text: Ben can send that. I don't want a theater demo with fake robots. Show me Harborview's shape: long hospital cycles, a few big lab-ops deals, a CEO who still joins forecast. If that looks honest, we'll do a working session with the AE lead.

transcript.speaker: Ben Adeyemi
transcript.text: I'll get you the sheet this week. One more context point: Harborview Labs isn't in anyone's system yet as far as I know — we haven't bought sales tooling before. Treat this as a net-new relationship, not an expansion of something else.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Understood — net new on our side too. I'll send the rollout one-pager and the trust links today. Once I have Ben's sheet I'll propose a working session. Thanks for the intro, both of you.

transcript.speaker: Keira Holt
transcript.text: Thanks Priya. Looking forward to it.
